name: context-library
title: Context library
summary: Agents find your plans, research, decisions and saved threads in a private notes repo, and you save new ones with one command.
day: You mention last week's planning in a prompt, and the agent gets a link to the note about it before it starts.
cost: You need a small private GitHub repo of Markdown notes. It syncs every five minutes, and saving a link runs one short agent.
risk: Agents read the library on every prompt, and saving a link writes a note from other people's text into it. Keep the repo private.

workflows.name: Context library
workflows.sentence: A prompt about a topic of your private notes repo gets links to its documents, fleet context searches and saves notes, and every machine pulls the repo every five minutes.
